title: fix: simplify app KPI views and start charts at zero
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Keeps All, CLI, Play / Website and Open WebUI as individual app views; smaller keys still count in the unchanged backend total.
- Starts nonnegative KPI charts at zero, including weekly revenue/signups, Pollen spend and both axes of usage/revenue. Negative metrics retain their negative range and include zero.
- Adds regression coverage for hidden app views, preserved totals and zero-based chart bounds.
- Verified focused Node checks against real KPI/scale functions, Biome and diff checks. Full Vitest unavailable locally because dependencies are absent and shell DNS is failing; CI validation pending. No Tinybird changes or deployment needed.

gist.headline: Charts find the floor
gist.blurb: The KPI dashboard keeps four app views in sight and gives nonnegative charts a proper zero. Smaller apps still count in the totals, even when they don't get their own tab.
gist.summary: The KPI dashboard keeps All, CLI, Play / Website, and Open WebUI as individual app views while preserving smaller keys in backend totals, and anchors nonnegative charts at zero without clipping negative metrics.
gist.impact: Dashboard viewers get simpler app comparisons and zero-based weekly revenue, signups, Pollen spend, and usage/revenue axes; negative values remain visible.
gist.visual_concept: Depict the internal KPI dashboard as a cozy retro monitor with four app-view tabs, small counters feeding a shared total, and chart lines visibly anchored to zero. Polli wears tiny analyst glasses and checks the axes; a code-plant beside the monitor brings in the garden motif.
gist.image_prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden workspace, a retro KPI monitor shows four simple app tabs and gentle chart lines beginning at a clearly marked zero, while tiny counters feed a shared total and a code-plant grows beside it. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium in the scene, wears tiny analyst glasses, and points warmly at the zero mark.
